notes: Q4-DS4 (#661) fit case: the same peer build and matched four-agent settings as peer-deepseek4.json, but serving ds4's DeepSeek-V4 Flash 0731 file (antirez/deepseek-v4-gguf rev f71f23d5, 86,720,111,488 bytes, sha256 ca22ae2f..., re-hashed locally 2026-11-02) instead of the hf2q artifact. It is a benchmark comparison artifact, not a substitute for hf2q conversion.

Artifact difference (disclosed in every result): same deepseek4 architecture, 43 blocks and 1,328 tensors as the hf2q artifact; routed experts IQ2_XXS gate/up and Q2_K down (hf2q: Q2_K gate/up, Q3_K down), shared experts Q8_0 (hf2q: Q2_K/Q3_K), compressor/indexer/hyper-connection projections and token_embd F16 (hf2q: Q8_0), router F16 (hf2q: F32). Tokenizer arrays are identical; the pre-tokenizer name differs (joyai-llm vs deepseek-v3) but the peer maps both to the same split regex (src/llama-vocab.cpp:327-329). nextn_predict_layers=1 without nextn tensors: the peer drops the MTP block (src/models/deepseek4.cpp:12-18).

Template: the GGUF embeds its own template (sha256 872492071c22..., 4,988 chars) with no reasoning_effort tiers, so it would render normal thinking for reasoning_effort=max. --chat-template-file binds the reviewed hf2q DeepSeek-V4 0731 template (sha256 aec3d906...), which the client requires on /props; prompts therefore render byte-identically to the hf2q arm's.

Fit memory (from the peer source, before the run): weights 80.8 GiB; per-sequence f16 compressed KV about 1.7 GiB (CSA 65,536 cells x 21 layers x 512 + lightning indexer 65,536 x 21 x 128 + HCA 2,048 x 20 x 512, K-only, padded to 256 cells), about 6.8 GiB for 4 x 262144; plus compute buffers and the host prompt cache (--cache-ram 8192). The device working-set limit on this host is 115,448,725,504 bytes (107.5 GiB, recommendedMaxWorkingSetSize). The hf2q artifact (100.05 GiB weights) exceeded it and hit kIOGPUCommandBufferCallbackErrorOutOfMemory ($E/peer-arms-v1); this file leaves about 15 GiB.

Best-valid-configuration knobs are variables: LOAD_MODE (auto = mmap, the peer default; none = copy into device buffers) and UBATCH (512, 1024, 2048 were the sweep points). KV type f16, flash attention on, no unified KV, 4 x 262144 and every reasoning/sampling control are the matched settings bound by family_peer.CONTROLS and the approval template; changing them is an operator decision.

Q4-DS4-RACE (#667) case of the ds4-file campaign of record: the defaults are the provisional best valid configuration from Q4-DS4 (load mode none, ubatch 1024; median makespan 65.2 s, within noise of auto/1024, $Q4DS4=/Users/robert/.local/state/hf2q/v0130/q4-ds4/runs/peer-*). These flags are finalized after the docs/research/adr066-iq2xxs-subset-design.md section 7.1 re-sweep (none/1024, auto/1024, none/512 on this file); --chat-template-file stays the reviewed aec3d906... template the client enforces. MODEL_SHA256 verification: the section 6.1 T2 full-file digest receipt (/Users/robert/.local/state/hf2q/v0130/q4-ds4-race/t2-digest.json, not written yet).

PEER_LOG_VERBOSITY 4 (trace) adds the load-time buffer sizes (model, DSV4 raw/CSA/HCA/indexer KV, compressor state, compute) and the per-task prompt-cache and checkpoint lines (restored checkpoint / forced full re-processing) to server.stderr; it logs per task, never per token. The per-task prompt/eval timings, graph-reuse counters and tg rate lines are logged at every verbosity.
No --kv-unified: see peer-deepseek4.json (the DSV4 cache keeps one stream per sequence). Run as a calibration (no --admission-receipt).
